programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky - Ravel - La Valse
programme.desc: The exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a performance of Maurice Ravel’s La Valse, in an arrangement for two pianos. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Davidsbündlertanze, Op. 6
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Davidsbündlertänze (Dances of the League of David), Op. 6, is a group of eighteen pieces for piano composed in 1837, named after Schumann's fictional music society Davidsbündler. In these, the active and the passive aspects of Schumann’s personality, represented by the characters Florestan and Eusebius, engage in musical dialogues about contemporary music. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène - Beethoven - String Quartet No. 7 And 13, and Op. 133
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer’s complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 7 in F major, Op. 59, No. 1, known as “Razumovsky”; String Quartet No. 13 in B-flat major, Op. 130; and the monumental Great Fugue, Op. 133. This concert performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on October 12, 2020.

programme.title: Sergei Nakariakov And Maria Meerovitch - Tchaikovsky - Lensky’s aria from Eugene Onegin
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023. As part of this concert, trumpetist Sergei Nakariakov and pianist Maria Meerovitch perform Lensky’s aria from Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s opera Eugene Onegin.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Conductor Zubin Mehta leads the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra in rehearsals for Richard Strauss's tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, capturing their collaborative musical dialogue.

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Fantasie in C, Op. 17
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Fantasie in C, Op. 17 in 1836, revising it prior to publication in 1839. Bearing a dedication to Franz Liszt, it is one of Schumann's greatest works for solo piano, and a central work of the early Romantic period. Written in a loose sonata form, the first movement is rhapsodic and passionate, the middle movement is a grandiose rondo, and the finale is slow and meditative. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press. The conductor's lucidity, efficiency, and lack of pretension, promoted a relaxed collaboration between himself and the orchestra, which is particularly evident in the rehearsal process. This ‘In Rehearsal’ episode features Salonen rehearsing Claude Debussy's Impressionistic orchestral piece La Mer with the Los Angeles Philharmonic at the Dorothy Chandler Pavilion of the Music Center of Los Angeles County. It gives a fascinating insight into Salonen’s rapport with his musicians and also into Debussy’s masterpiece.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024
programme.desc: Pianist Anthony Ratinov (USA, 1997) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Sostenuto assai – Allegro ma non troppo, of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quartet in E-flat major, Op. 47. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM). It was recorded at the Bourgie Hall of the Montreal Museum of Fine Arts.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan And Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris - Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, ‘Eroica’. Composed in 1803 and 1804, this symphony is regarded as a major turning point in Beethoven’s oeuvre as well as Western music history. Symphony No. 3 is longer in duration than any previous symphony. The customary long introduction is replaced by two powerful chords, followed by the introduction of the main theme by the lower strings. The slow second movement is a Funeral March, followed by a quick Scherzo. The fourth and final movement is dominated by a theme from Beethoven’s ballet music for ‘The Creatures of Prometheus’. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky - Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven And Glazunov
programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. Lugansky opens his concert with Beethoven’s Piano Sonata No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 27 No. 2, ‘Moonlight’, followed by Alexander Glazunov’s Piano Sonata No. 2 in E minor, Op. 75. Then Lugansky performs a selection of works by Rachmaninoff: Rachmaninoff’s piano transcription of J. S. Bach’s Partita No. 3 in E major; a selection of Études-Tableaux (Nos. 1, 2, 4, and 8, Op, 33, and Nos. 5 and 6, Op. 39); Lilac (Op. 21, No. 5); Prelude in C minor, Op. 23 No. 7; and Rachmaninoff’s transcription of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Lullaby (Op. 16 No. 1). This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on June 4, 2021.

programme.title: Andrea Bacchetti - Bach - Goldberg Variations, BWV 988
programme.desc: At the age of eleven, Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti (*1977) debuted with Italian chamber orchestra I Solisti Veneti under the baton of Claudio Scimone. He performed on international festivals and in prestigious concert halls worldwide. Besides, he appeared with several renowned orchestras such as Lucerne Festival Strings, Camerata Salzburg, and Prague Chamber Orchestra. In the current recital, Bacchetti performs J. S. Bach’s celebrated Goldberg Variations, BWV 988. Completed in 1741, the work is named after German harpsichordist Johann Gottlieb Goldberg, who might have been the first to have performed the work. Bach’s masterpiece consists of an aria and a set of thirty variations. Rather than writing variations on the aria’s melody, Bach used the accompanying bass line as his starting point. This performance was recorded at Theater Carlo Felice in Genoa, Italy, on April 13, 2015.

programme.title: Barbara Hannigan And Cleveland Orchestra - Barbara Hannigan at Severance Hall
programme.desc: Barbara Hannigan, soprano and conductor, won the Grammy for “Best Classical Solo Vocal Album CRAZY GIRL CRAZY (Gershwin, Berg and Berio) 2018 and took home the Grammy for “Artist of the Year” in 2022. In autumn 2023 she made her long-awaited conducting debut with the Cleveland Orchestra. The programme featured an interesting mix of old and new with Haydn´s Symphony No. 44 in E-minor, Vivier´s Lonely Child', Ligeti´s 'Lontano' and Death and Transfiguration by Richard Strauss.

programme.title: Václav Luks And Collegium 1704 - Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach’s Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. In this performance at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany, Luks and his Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 2 in F major, BWV 1047. This piece features trumpet, violin, recorder, and oboe solos. Especially outstanding are the high, virtuoso trumpet parts.

programme.title: Ballet of the Mariinsky Theatre - La Bayadère
programme.desc: 'La Bayadère' is a three-act ballet by the French choreographer Marius Petipa. Set in 19th-century India, 'La Bayadère' tells the sad love story of the noble warrior Solor and his Nikia, a temple dancer or 'bayadère', who is poisoned by her rival, Gamzatti. The ballet features one of the most celebrated scenes of classical ballet, namely 'The Kingdom of the Shades'. In this iconic scene, Solor dreams, under the influence of opium, of reuniting with his beloved Nikia. This production of the ballet features the revised choreography by Vladimir Ponomarev and Vakhtang Chabukiani (1941), and includes dances by Konstantin Sergeyev and Nikolai Zubkovsky. The ballet’s music, composed by Ludwig Minkus, is performed by the Mariinsky Orchestra under the direction of Boris Gruzin. Among the performers are Viktoria Tereshkina, Anastasia Matvienko, Vladimir Shklyarov, and Vladimir Ponomarev. This performance was recorded at the Mariinsky Theatre in St. Petersburg, Russia, in July 2014.

programme.title: Giovanni Guzzo, Matthew Raymond Origel, Marlin González Zúñiga And Marc Ferrando Pelegrí - Works by Gluck, Bach and Mozart
programme.desc: Venezuelan-born conductor Giovanni Guzzo leads the Camerata Fundación EDP of the Reina Sofía School of Music in a spirited concert. The program opens with the ethereal ‘Danza degli spiriti beati’ (Dance of the Blessed Spirits) from Christoph Willibald Gluck’s opera Orfeo ed Euridice, featuring flutist Matthew Raymond Origel. The concert continues with vocal masterworks, including J.S. Bach’s brilliant cantata aria ‘Jauchzet Gott in allen Landen!’, BWV 51, featuring soprano Marlin González Zúñiga and trumpeter Marc Ferrando Pelegrí, and W.A. Mozart’s joyous motet Exsultate, jubilate, K. 165, sung by soprano Carla Isabel Gómez del Pulgar. The concert concludes with one of the great classical works: Mozart’s dramatic Symphony No. 40 in G minor. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Sony of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, Spain, on December 18, 2024.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst And Cleveland Orchestra - Mozart - Symphony No. 36 'Linz'
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing a charming work by Mozart, with a sentimental connection to the conductor: Symphony No. 36 'Linz is named after the hometown of Welser-Möst. Mozart wrote the piece when stopping over on a trip from Vienna to Salzburg. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in January 2022.

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Saint-Saëns - Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op. 94; Frédéric Chopin’s Impromptu No. 3, Op. 51, Polonaise No. 6, Op. 53 “Heroic”, and Waltz No. 6, Op. 64 No. 1; Camille Saint-Saëns’s Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77; César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major; and Fritz Kreisler’s Liebesleid and Schön Rosmarin. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.

programme.title: Iván Fischer - Mozart - Symphony No. 34, KV. 338
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Antonín Dvořák. Mozart’s Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338 opens the program. Completed in the summer of 1780, this was the last symphony Mozart wrote in Salzburg, where he worked as a court musician. The three-movement symphony features two vibrant outer movements with fanfares and rousing themes, while the quieter second movement is scored for strings alone, deviating from the typical four-movement structure of the time. Next on the program is Dvořák’s Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70, completed in March 1885 and premiered one month later in London conducted by the composer himself. With its dramatic and dark style, this symphony stands in stark contrast to the predominantly optimistic tone of Dvořák’s broader oeuvre. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, on January 29, 2021.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Beauty is a Crime
programme.desc: Greek conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside Austrian-Moldovan violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians. For this concert, they went searching for a new definition of the meaning of the word beauty. Thus, this 2015 performance from the renowned Musikfest Bremen sheds an entirely new light on two beloved classics by Brahms and Mendelssohn. The concert programme features Felix Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto in E minor and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 3 in F Major.

programme.title: Iván Fischer and the Budapest Festival Orchestra
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in an exciting concert program consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók, and Johannes Brahms. The program opens with Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. This is followed by one of Bartók’s best-known pieces: Music for strings, percussion and celesta. Remarkable is the work’s instrumentation: Bartók divided the strings into two groups that are placed on opposite sides of the stage, to create antiphonal effects. The program ends with Brahms’s Symphony No. 3 in F major, Op. 90. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on December 4, 2017.

programme.title: Inna Faliks - Chopin - Polonaise-fantaisie, Op. 61
programme.desc: Ukrainian-born pianist Inna Faliks performs Frederic Chopin's Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61. Recorded at the Nicols Concert Hall, Evanston, IL, USA. Faliks has established herself as one of the most communicative, and poetic artists of her generation. The Polonaise-Fantaise was dedicated to Mme A. Veyret, composed and published in 1846

programme.title: Christoph Eschenbach, Konzerthausorchester Berlin And Rundfunkchor Berlin - Von Weber - Der Freischütz
programme.desc: This unique production of Carl Maria von Weber’s ‘Der Freischütz’ was created to celebrate both the piece’s 200th premiere anniversary at Konzerthaus Berlin and the 200th anniversary of the famed concert hall itself. For this production, Catalan theatre group La Fura dels Baus – internationally acclaimed for its avant-garde opera – created a virtual forest in the Konzerthaus’ Great Hall, delivering a thrilling new interpretation of Von Weber’s Romantic opera. Stage director Carlus Padrissa calls this 2021 production a “journey to the roots of opera, where myth, history and the current reality of the forest meet”. Christoph Eschenbach conducts Konzerthausorchester Berlin and Rundfunkchor Berlin. Among the soloists are Jeanine De Bique (Agathe), Anna Prohaska (Ännchen), Benjamin Bruns (Max), Falk Struckmann (Kaspar), Franz Hawlata (Kuno), and Viktor Rud (Kilian). This performance was recorded on June 18, 2021.

programme.title: Walton: Viola Concerto and Brahms: Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: British conductor Robin Ticciati conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of William Walton’s Viola Concerto and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98. When the young Walton premiered his Viola Concerto in 1927, it caused a Europe-wide sensation: a composer in his twenties, taking a neglected instrument and writing for it with unprecedented imagination and power. Viola virtuoso Antoine Tamestit features as the soloist in this Concerto. Brahms’s Symphony No. 4 would be the composer’s last – but every note burns with creative fire. This concert, which unites youthful genius with music drawn from a profound engagement with life, was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s on Old Street in London, UK, on October 14, 2021.

programme.title: Heavenly Voices
programme.desc: The story of the castrato in music – male singers who were castrated at a young age in order to preserve their high vocal range, a cruel practice that was in place mainly in the 17th and 18th centuries.

programme.title: Andrés Orozco-Estrada And Orquesta Sinfónica Freixenet de la Escuela Superior de Música Reina Sofía - Dvořák - Symphony No. 8 in G major, Op. 88
programme.desc: Colombian principal conductor Andrés Orozco-Estrada took the Spanish Orquesta Sinfónica Freixenet on the road to perform at some of Europe’s greatest music centers in celebration of Madrid’s Reina Sofía School of Music’s 30th anniversary. This concert features a wonderful performance of Antonín Dvořák’s Symphony No. 8 in G major, Op. 88. It was recorded at the Liszt Ferenc Academy of Music in Budapest, Hungary on October 20, 2021.

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Schubert - Rondo D. 951
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï perform Franz Schubert’s Rondo in A major, D. 951.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra - Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 5, Op. 73
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker, Daniel Barenboim and Claudio Abbado star at the Europakonzert 1994 in Meiningen, Germany, performing Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 5 and Johannes Brahms’ Symphony No. 2. Popularly known as the Emperor Concerto and composed in Vienna between 1809 and 1811, Piano Concerto No. 5 is Beethoven’s last completed piano concerto and often performed by star pianists such as Daniel Barenboim. A few decades later in 1877, Brahms completed his Second Symphony, which is often compared to Beethoven’s Sixth Symphony given its cheerful and pastoral character.

programme.title: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy led by French conductor Jean-Jacques Kantorow. First on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Sinfonia Concertante in E-flat major, K. 364, in which Capuçon and violist Gérard Caussé appear as the soloists. Capuçon is then joined by pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï for a performance of Mozart’s Sonata for violin and piano in E minor, K. 304. The program closes with Dmitri Shostakovich’s Chamber Symphony in C minor, Op. 110a, which is a transcription of Shostakovich’s String Quartet No. 8 by Russian conductor Rudolf Barshai, the composer’s close friend. This performance was recorded at Château de Chantilly, on May 15, 2021.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: The soloists from the Lucerne Festival Orchestra present Ludwig van Beethoven’s Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20, which is scored for clarinet, horn, bassoon, violin, viola, cello and double bass. This 1799 piece achieved great popularity during Beethoven’s lifetime. It was arranged for many various instrumental ensembles, including versions for two guitars, and piano four-hands, but also a trio for clarinet (or violin), cello, and piano, arranged by Beethoven himself. This performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in 2020.

programme.title: Clara Haskil - Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète
programme.desc: The documentary “Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète” (2017) tells the remarkable life story of Romanian pianist Clara Haskil (1895-1960). Born in Bucharest into a Jewish family, she began her career as a child prodigy, entering the Bucharest Conservatory at a very young age. She continued her music studies in Vienna and Paris. Haskil suffered from chronic health issues and lived through two world wars, which held back her career. Only after WWII, Haskil’s fame began to take off and she finally enjoyed international recognition. She performed as a soloist over the world with the foremost orchestras, and collaborated with acclaimed musicians including Eugène Ysaÿe, George Enescu, and Pablo Casals.

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Shostakovich - Concertino for two pianos
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op. 94; Frédéric Chopin’s Impromptu No. 3, Op. 51, Polonaise No. 6, Op. 53 “Heroic”, and Waltz No. 6, Op. 64 No. 1; Camille Saint-Saëns’s Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77; César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major; and Fritz Kreisler’s Liebesleid and Schön Rosmarin. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Frans Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus, Siobhan Stagg And Avery Amereau - Strauss' Metamorphosen And Mozart's Requiem
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto), Ben Bliss (tenor) and Anthony Robin Schneider (bass). Recorded at Severance Hall, Cleveland in March 2023.

programme.title: Glenn Gould - Music in the air
programme.desc: Television plays a crucial role in popularizing classical music. Not only has it preserved precious moments of music making, but it also helps shape the future of music. The Vienna-based IMZ International Music + Media Centre, a global association for all those involved in any aspect of classical and contemporary music, world music, jazz, and dance, celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2015. To commemorate this, renowned film maker Reiner E. Moritz produced the documentary 'Music in the air' to shed light on the history of classical music on television. The film dives into television's archives to demonstrate what the medium has done for the dissemination of music. It features rare footage of Arturo Toscanini conducting the NBC Symphony Orchestra in one of the first televised concerts, and captivating fragments from Leonard Bernstein’s Young People Concerts. Moreover, the film contains excerpts of great performances from the past, including those by Glenn Gould, Herbert von Karajan, Igor Stravinsky, and Pierre Boulez.

programme.title: London Symphony Orchestra And Michael Tilson Thomas - Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17
programme.desc: American conductor Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in an energetic performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's folk-infused Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17. Written in 1872, the work is nicknamed 'Little Russian' as the composer used several folk tunes from Ukraine, then known as ‘Little Russia’. This performance was recorded at LSO St Luke's, London, on May 31, 2021.

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Kreisleriana, Op. 16
programme.desc: Celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz presents a performance of Robert Schumann's dramatic Kreisleriana, Op. 16, an eight-movement masterpiece inspired by the fictional writings of E. T. A. Hoffmann.

programme.title: Václav Luks And Collegium 1704 - Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach’s Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. In this performance at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany, Luks and his Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 4 in G major, BWV 1049. This concerto features solos from two recorders and a violin. The recorders play a prominent role in the concerto’s second movement, while the violin dominates the fast first and third movements.

programme.title: Zhu Xiao-Mei - Bach - Goldberg Variations (BWV 988)
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) at the Leipzig Bach Festival. This June 2014 concert was recorded at St. Thomas Church, where Bach spent most time of his career as 'Thomaskantor', the musical director of the Thomanerchor church choir. The Goldberg Variations consist of one aria and a set of 30 variations. The work was first published in 1741 and was named after harpsichordist Johann Gottlieb Goldberg. In contrast to melodic variations on a theme, the Goldberg Variations do not follow the melody, but rather use the aria's bass line and chord progression. Every third variation in the series of 30 is a canon that follows an ascending pattern. The Goldberg Variations are among Bach's most celebrated works, which gained an even larger audience thanks to Glenn Gould's legendary recordings of the work in 1955 and 1981.

programme.title: Martha Argerich, Iddo Bar-Shai, Maxim Vengerov And Mischa Maisky - Works by Beethoven and Saint-Saëns
programme.desc: In May and June 2021, Argentinian star pianist Martha Argerich celebrated her 80th birthday performing at Château de Chantilly, France. In this concert, recorded at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, Argerich is joined by three musicians who are particularly close to her heart: cellist Mischa Maisky, violinist Maxim Vengerov, and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï. They perform with the orchestra Les Siècles under the baton of Romanian-Austrian conductor Ion Marin. The concert opens with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Triple Concerto in C major, Op. 56, with Argerich, Vengerov, and Maisky as soloists. Written in 1803, it is Beethoven’s only concerto for more than one solo instrument. This is followed by Camille Saint-Saëns’s musical suite The Carnival of the Animals (Le carnaval des animaux), featuring Argerich and Bar-Shaï as the pianists. This musical suite from 1886 consists of 14 movements, each depicting a different animal. The work was published posthumously in 1922, as Saint-Saëns was concerned that his animal miniatures, full of delightful jokes, might damage his reputation as a serious composer. This performance was recorded at Château de Chantilly, on May 4, 2021.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan, Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris, Choeur de l’Opéra national de Paris And Ricarda Merbeth - Beethoven - Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, maestro Jordan presents Beethoven’s final symphony: Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. He conducts the Orchestre and Choeurs de l’Opéra national de Paris and four vocal soloists Ricarda Merbeth (soprano), Daniela Sindram (mezzosoprano), Robert Dean Smith (tenor), and Günther Groissböck (bass). Beethoven composed his last Symphony when his hearing had all but gone, between 1822 and 1824. Symphony No. 9 is the longest and most ambitious of Beethoven’s symphonies. Most striking is the piece’s finale movement, which includes a choir and four vocal soloists singing a setting of Friedrich Schiller’s poem ‘An die Freude’ (Ode to Joy). This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Piano Concerto No. 4 And Nielsen 6th
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of two great works. Paganini’s Violin Concerto No. 1. is paired with Brahms’ dramatic symphonic debut, Symphony No.1. Paganini’s concerto dates from the mid-to-late 1810s, written as the composer was touring Italy with his remarkable violin technique. This piece is a quintessential expression of Paganini’s extraordinary skill and ability, demanding much from the soloist. It is also characterized by the notably operatic “bel canto” style adopted by many of the composer’s contemporaries, including Gioachino Rossini. This exceptional performance features the dazzling virtuosity of violinist In Mo Yang, winner of the 2015 Paganini Competition. It was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2017.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène - Beethoven - String Quartet No. 5, Op. 18, No. 5
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer’s complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 5 in A major, Op. 18, No. 5; String Quartet No. 4 in C minor, Op. 18, No. 4; and String Quartet No. 12 in E-flat major, Op. 127. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 17, 2020.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37. Russian-born pianist Maya Oganyan (*2005) makes her solo debut with the orchestra. Beethoven composed this concerto in 1800 and played the piano part himself at the piece’s premiere in 1803. Like two of his other major works –Symphony No. 5 and Piano Sonata No. 8 ‘Pathétique’ – this piano concerto is written in the key of C minor, which contributes to the work’s stormy character. As an encore, Oganyan performs Der Bote (‘The Messenger’) by Ukrainian composer Valentin Silvestrov. This performance was recorded at the Aram Khachaturian Concert Hall in Yerevan, Armenia, in 2021.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle And London Symphony Orchestra - Dvořák – Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1–8)
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Antonín Dvořák’s spirited Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1-8). These 16 folk dances earned Dvořák, who was a relative newcomer when he wrote them, great success. Originally composed for piano four hands, the London Symphony Orchestra plays the orchestral version of these brilliant works. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s on Old Street in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.

programme.title: John Adams - The Unanswered Ives
programme.desc: “The Unanswered Ives” is the first documentary about American modernist composer Charles Ives (1874-1954). Ives was among the first generation of American composers that achieved international acclaim. Born in 1874, in Danbury, Connecticut, Ives took music lessons at a young age, becoming a church organist at the age of 14. Following his graduation from the music department at Yale University, the young composer decided to pursue a career outside of the arts. He started working in insurance, co-founding an innovative and highly successful insurance company. It was in his spare time that Ives composed his ambitious music, in which he experimented with advanced features including polytonality, twelve-tone technique, and quarter tones. The documentary film “The Unanswered Ives” (2018) sheds light on Ives’s life and work in all its facets, exploring his aural world by showing music performances in churches, concert halls, open-air venues, and a circus tent. Using interviews with relatives, insurance brokers, musicologists, and musicians, documentary filmmaker Anne-Kathrin Peitz explores the question “who was Charles Ives?

programme.title: Welser-Möst conducts Farrenc, Ravel And Mussorgsky
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a March 2023 concert featuring Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G with soloist Víkingur Ólafsson, and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition orchestrated by Ravel.

programme.title: Isabelle Faust - Bach - Partita for Violin No. 2 (BWV 1004)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs J. S. Bach’s Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004). The work is part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Partita No. 2 is made up of four dance movements, concluded by its famous Chaconne, a monumental piece within the violin repertoire. In this Chaconne, Bach develops a series of continuous variations from a theme, exploring a complex range of harmonic possibilities. This performance was recorded at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, in 2020.

programme.title: Sinne Eeg And Jimmy J¢rgensen - Cartoons in Concert
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras. Cartoons are for children and adults alike - and the music in them is at least as entertaining as the pictures! It will be fun, touching, crazy and dramatic when the Concert Hall is filled with living lines drawn in tones in the big room. The DR Symphony Orchestra, DR Big Band and DR Vocal Ensemble have joined forces to take you to a party in the cartoon universes.

programme.title: Mariss Jansons And Oslo Philharmonic - In Rehearsal: Mariss Jansons
programme.desc: Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons (1943-2019) was one of the world’s leading conductors. He served as Music Director of the Oslo Philharmonic from 1979 to 2000, during which time he transformed the orchestra into a front-rank ensemble. Under his leadership, the orchestra toured extensively and became a favorite at major festivals worldwide. The Oslo Philharmonic was celebrated for its fresh, open sound and for Jansons’s passionate interpretations of works by Dmitri Shostakovich, Richard Strauss, Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky, and Béla Bartók. In this episode of ‘In Rehearsal,’ Jansons guides the orchestra through the powerful Suite from Bartók’s pantomime ballet The Miraculous Mandarin, culminating in a performance at the Oslo Concert Hall.

programme.title: Daniel Oren And Orchestra dell'Arena di Verona - Verdi - Nabucco
programme.desc: Israeli-born conductor Daniel Oren leads the Orchestra of the Arena di Verona in a magnificent interpretation of Giuseppe Verdi's Nabucco. Verdi’s third opera – but first great popular success – was created at the Teatro alla Scala in Milan in 1842, in the epicentre of the “Risorgimento” and the capital of Italian nationalism, at a time where the supporters of Italian independence from Austrian occupation were starting to make their voices heard. The Chorus of the Hebrew slaves, pivotal point in the third act where the Jews, exiled from Babylone by Nabuchodonosor, mourn their country, So Beautiful and Lost, immediately resonated with the Italian nationalists and has ever since been a symbol of Italian national identity. Daniel Oren, a true connoisseur of Verdi’s musical language as well as a regular guest at the Arena di Verona, conducts with great panache this lyrical epic that holds such a special place in the heart of all Italians. This interpretation was recorded 2017 and stars George Gagnidze, Susanna Branchini, Nino Surguladze, Rubens Pelizzari, Stanislav Trofimov and more.

programme.title: Andrea Molteni - Berg - Piano Sonata, Op. 1
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Molteni (1998) performs Alban Berg’s Piano Sonata in B minor, Op. 1. Molteni began studying the piano at the age of six. He graduated with honors and honorable mention at the Conservatorio di musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como, and was awarded a master’s degree Magna cum Laude in Advanced Performance Studies by the Conservatorio della Svizzera Italiana in Lugano. He has appeared at the Wiener Saal of the Mozarteum University in Salzburg, Scriabin Museum in Moscow, National Opera Center in New York, and several other international venues. This performance was recorded at the Verbrugghen Hall of the Sydney Conservatorium of Music, Australia, in 2023.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Alexandre Tharaud - Beethoven - Last Sonatas, Op. 109, 110 And 111
programme.desc: Beethoven’s last three sonatas – Opus 109, 110 and 111 – explore the intimate meanders of the human soul, from despair to transfiguration. At the time of their composition, Beethoven was already locked in himself by his deafness. This deeply affected his relationship to others and to the world. This psychological framework is explored by director Mariano Nante, setting pianist Alexandre Tharaud in a film inspired by the universe of Tarkovski. Filmed in abandoned castles, and lit by director of photography Yorgos Arvanitis, this work evokes solitude and introspection and offers an inner journey through images and music.

programme.title: The Galileo Project: Music of the Spheres
programme.desc: The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra, also known simply as Tafelmusik, is a Toronto-based Canadian baroque orchestra, specialised in early music. The ensemble is directed by violinist Jeanne Lamon. In ‘The Galileo Project: Music of the Spheres’ they perform music by Monteverdi, Vivaldi, Bach and Handel to a backdrop of high-definition images from the Hubble telescope, NASA and Canadian astronomers. Explore the fusion of arts, science and culture in the 17th and 18th centuries in this imaginative concert commemorating Galileo’s first public demonstration of the telescope. Actor Shaun Smyth narrates a compelling script while the musicians weave in and around a magical stage set by Marshal Pynkoski. Created and scripted by Alison Mackay.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Trio élégiaque No. 1
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023. As part of this concert, violinist Alissa Margulis, cellist Mischa Maisky, and pianist Lily Maisky perform Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Trio élégiaque No. 1 in G minor.

programme.title: Olivier Latry - In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally. He sees himself as an ambassador of French music from the 17th through the 20th centuries as well as an advocate for the art of improvisation. Pieces played in the film are: Pierre Cochereau’s Boléro, Louis Vierne’s Carillon of Westminster and Scherzo from Symphony No. 2, Alexandre Guilmant’s Sonata No. 1, Charles-Marie Widor’s Gothic Symphony, Marcel Dupre’s Cortège, Litanie and J. S. Bach’s Passacaille And Fugue.

programme.title: Peppa Wutz
programme.desc: Peppa und ihre Familie besuchen Elena Esel in Paris. Dort möchte Papa Wutz sich einfach alles anschauen. Doch das ist schwierig, wenn sie nur einen Tag dafür Zeit haben.

programme.title: Peppa Wutz

programme.title: Paw Patrol

programme.title: Neue Geschichten vom Pumuckl

Als dann auch noch nachts ein Unwetter über sie hereinbricht und sie vor einem vermeintlichen Bären flüchten müssen, ist es ein Glück, dass Nachbar Burke mit seinem Wohnmobil nicht weit ist.

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: Alex hat sich ein Super-Dreirad gebaut, das aber leider bei der ersten Fahrt kaputt gegangen ist. Nun will die Paw Patrol Alex dabei helfen, ein noch besseres Super-Dreirad zu bauen.

programme.title: Paw Patrol

programme.title: Paw Patrol

programme.title: Per och Marie - historien om Roxette
programme.desc: När The Look briserar 1989 blir Roxette stora i Sverige men drömmen om en internationell karriär verkar inte slå in. Inte förrän en utbytesstudent i USA lyckas få singeln spelad händer något - men då händer det med besked. Per och Marie ger sig ut på en enorm promotionturné och snart följer fler listettor i USA. Genom deras privata filmer får vi följa med på resan från The Look till Joyride - men den enorma framgången har också ett pris.

programme.title: Innanför slottets väggar
programme.desc: Prinsessan Christina och kung Carl XVI Gustaf växte upp i den södra flygeln i det Kungliga slottet i Stockholm. Kronprinsessan Victoria bodde också fem år i detta slott. Hur var det? Vilka är deras starkaste minnen från barndomen i en så speciell uppväxtmiljö?

programme.title: DNA-spåret: Dubbelmordet i Brattås
programme.desc: Tor och Gerd hittas mördade på sin gård utanför Brattås. Ett DNA-spår från en okänd man säkras - fyndet kommer 20 år senare att få avgörande betydelse i utredningen. Men den första sommaren riktas misstankarna i stället mot personer i parets närhet och mot människor i bygden kring Brattås.

programme.title: Skärgårdsdoktorn - syntolkat
programme.desc: Sören fiskar upp en flyktingfamilj långt ute i havsbandet, och Johan tvingas fatta en rad moraliska beslut. Sören har fullt upp med en stadsfamilj som bestämt sig för att leka Robinson en vecka.

programme.title: 1% Klubben - syntolkat
programme.desc: I detta avsnitt ställs deltagarna bland annat inför frågan: Om fem plankor har tio ändar, hur många ändar finns det då på sju och en halv planka? Vet du svaret? Vem tar sig hela vägen till den avgörande 1%-frågan? 100 tävlande sätts på prov i logik och problemlösning när frågorna blir svårare och svårare. Hur långt hade du klarat dig? Programledare: Johan Petersson.

programme.title: Sveriges nästa stjärnkock - New York
programme.desc: Det har blivit dags för årets överlägset mest hektiska kväll på New Yorks restauranger - alla hjärtans dag. Både Barbuto och Aska är fullbokade, och nu måste kockarna visa att de klarar pressen när allt ställs på sin spets. Frank konfronteras med ett grovt misstag från en tidigare kväll, medan Astrid anländer till Aska i kläder som bryter mot klädkoden. Nu måste köksmästare Fredrik fatta ett avgörande beslut: får hon stanna och köra service - eller skickas hon hem?

programme.title: Kjempemaskiner
programme.desc: Hadde det ikke vært for brøytebilen hadde det vært farlig for andre kjøretøy å ferdes på veier fulle av snø og is. Å brøyte er en jobb full av utfordringer, det får Bamse Broom merke når han er med Espen og brøyter på fjellet.

programme.title: Monstermaling

programme.title: Oiii's naturpatrulje finner kryp
programme.desc: Når de to brødrene fra byen skal ut og lete etter kadavere for å finne dagens kryp, må de bruke luktesansen godt. Heldigvis har de lært å tenke som åtselbillen, Gabriel og Mikail må nemlig gjennom det slimete guggeløpet som en del av forberedelsene.

programme.title: Bakebasillen
programme.desc: Thea og Elin viser hvordan du lager en enkel brøddeig på kjøkkenet som du kan ta med ut på tur. Tvinn deigen rundt din egen spikret pinne og gjør bålmiddagen ekstra god med pinnebrød!

programme.title: Mr.Bean
programme.desc: Mr. Bean trenger nye og spennende venner og bestemmer seg for å kjøpe en papegøye. Husverten hans er ikke glad for dette, og han må snike fuglen forbi henne og den enøyde katten hennes.

programme.title: Sommerdrømmer
programme.desc: Guttene går all in på spa-stemning, mens Kien er redd for å skuffe Clara igjen. Katrine og Rasmus frykter fugejobben og glemmer at det er viktig å tørke, mens Martin er i flisehimmelen.

programme.title: Live: God morgen Norge
programme.desc: God morgen Norge byr på aktuelle temaer og kjente gjester hver morgen fra mandag til fredag, fra studio i Lilleakerbyen.

programme.title: Stumble
programme.desc: Courteney indgår en aftale med ejeren af Button Factory: Hvis hendes hold leverer en imponerende opvisning, skriver han en stor check til hendes afdeling.

programme.title: Dance Moms
programme.desc: Yderst ambitiøse mødre og unge dansere kæmper for succes i et benhårdt konkurrence­miljø, hvor talent, pres og konflikter går hånd i hånd – både på scenen og bag kulisserne.

programme.title: Et Ton Cash
programme.desc: I første afsnit et ton cash, går det hurtigt op for deltagerne, hvor krævende det er at flytte et helt ton mønter, gennem Råbjerg Miles sandede bakker. Samarbejde og sammenhold er der ikke meget af. Holdkaptajnen kommer til at blive en dyr fornøjelse og alt tyder på, det er de svageste på holdet, der ryger hjem først.

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Forsidefruen Gunnvør går i fødsel, men faren til barnet, modellen Oliver Bjerrehuus, er ikke med på hospitalet. De to har nemlig ikke været på talefod i mange måneder. Janni har en plan om at overraske sin 25 år ældre mand, milliardæren Karsten Ree, med en romantisk indsprøjtning i deres forhold. Men det er ikke nemt, da Karsten bestemt ikke bryder sig om romantik.

programme.title: Luksusfælden
programme.desc: Cathrine og Kent på 32 år bor med deres to døtre på 3 og 6 år i Løjt Kirkeby i Sønderjylland. Hun arbejder som pædagog i en naturbørnehave, og han har tidligere haft sin egen tøjbutik, men er nu uden arbejde. Familiens økonomi er tynget af den gæld Kent har fra sit tidligere firma.

programme.title: Luksusfælden
programme.desc: Marianne på 37 bor i Edinburgh i Skotland. I 2004 tog hun sin drømmeuddannelse som pilot. Hun finansierede selv uddannelsen på over 800.000 kroner, men hendes far måtte kautionere for de 300.000 kr. og banken tog pant i familiens kolonihavehus for 450.000.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen
programme.desc: Linse og Mor Ann så for nylig en lampe af træ i en butik, som Linse var meget begejstret for. Mor Ann er dog ret sikker på at hun kan lave en ligeså godt selv.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen
programme.desc: Der sker et par forandringer på Bryggen. Linse har besluttet sig for at skifte branche, så hun vil sælge sin tatoo-shop og i stedet bruge alt sin tid og energi på sit helt nye tøjmærke. Men inden da skal det nye tøj lige prøves af, så Linse inviterer Mor Ann forbi til at gå catwalk og lege fotomodel i hendes stue.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen
programme.desc: Der er fart over feltet på Bryggen. Stephanie er tæt på at være færdig med at tage sit kørekort. Men der er stadig nogle ting hun ikke er helt tryg ved endnu, f.eks. at køre på motorvej. Så hendes kørelærer tager hende med ud på hendes forhåbentlig sidste køretime, som bliver mere dramatisk end først forventet.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen
programme.desc: På Bryggen går det op og ned med følelserne. Linse inviterer Stephanie med et smut til Fyn for at støtte en god sag. De har nemlig samlet penge sammen til en organisation som redder burhøns og det bliver en lidt hård omgang for de glade dyre-elskere.

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Tina, Amalie og Janni besøger Gunnvør for at se hendes lille nyfødte dreng, som hun har fået med modellen Oliver Bjerrehus. Og dramaet udfoldes, da Gunnvør pludselig åbner op for veninderne, om den konflikt der er opstået mellem hende og Sarah Louise. Gunnvør og Oliver diskuterer om, at Gunnvør bør få sagt fra over for veninden Sarah Louise. Tina Lund har bestilt et forløb med den personlige træner Kira Eggers.

programme.title: Med Kniven for Struben
programme.desc: Restaurant Limone drives af ægteparret Johnny og Helle. Restauranten, der ligger inde i en biograf, kæmper med at få gæster til at komme og spise - og ikke bare gå i biografen. Men er maden er værd at blive siddende for? Og Helles arbejdsgiver har passiviseret alle omkring hende, så det nu er hende alene, der står med alt ansvaret. Spørgsmålet er, hvor længe hun kan holde til det?

programme.title: Luksusfælden
programme.desc: Louise og Simon har netop fået deres første fælles barn, Milas. Louise er flyttet ind i Simons store hus med sin søn fra et tidligere forhold, Vincent. Men med Louise følger også en stor gæld. Simon har styr på sin økonomi og nu plages Louise af dårlig samvittighed over ikke at kunne bidrage til deres fælles liv på lige fod med sin kæreste. Louise må vælge mellem gældfrihed og lighed i parforholdet. Og spørgsmålet er så, om Simon kan støtte Louises beslutning også økonomisk.

programme.title: EHF Champions League After-Studio

programme.title: EHF Men's Champions League

programme.title: EHF Champions League After-Studio

Da hun drages af to unge mænd fra byen, opdager Kya en ny og betagende verden; men da den ene af dem dør, bliver hun omgående mistænkt for forbrydelsen. Som sagen udvikler sig, bliver sandheden mere og mere uklar og truer med at afsløre mange af marskens hemmeligheder.

programme.title: The Gunman
programme.desc: Jim, en tidligere lejemorder, jages af sin fortid, da hans forhenværende arbejdsgivere sætter en pris på hans hoved. De er også ude efter Anne, en smuk kvinde, som han forlod flere år tidligere. Terrier indser, at der kun er en måde at redde Anne og ham selv på - han må afsløre og knuse verdens mægtigste organisation og møde fjenderne fra sin fortid i en kamp, hvor kun en mand kan overleve.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen
programme.desc: Kom i godt selskab med yndlingsfamilien fra Bryggen. Vi følger hverdagen for Linse, Stephanie, Cengiz, Alba, Didde og alle de andre – i både medgang og modgang.

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Sarah Louise holder storslået fødselsdagsfest på et slot, og alle er inviterede. Hun bliver 35 år, og det skal fejres med rød løber, store kjoler og en privat sanger. Hun får nok at se til, da maden ikke er klar og sangeren ikke er mødt op som aftalt. Pressen er inviteret til at blitze løs, når gæsterne ankommer, og til Sarahs store overraskelse er Janni kommet til at invitere Amalies ekskæreste, ’Ulven’Peter, med til festen!

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Konflikten mellem Gunnvør og Sarah Louise er brudt ud, og det er Sarah mildest talt træt af. De to fruer har stadig ikke fået snakket sammen, og nu har Janni inviteret alle fruerne ud på en lækker yacht. Sarah Louise og Gunnvør er derfor nødt til at forholde sig til hinanden, men prøver begge at lade som ingenting på sejlturen. Det synes Janni er noget pjat, og hun spørger derfor ind til det ømme emne.

programme.title: Luksusfælden
programme.desc: I Vejle bor Birgitte og Daniel med deres fælles datter, Ellen. Birgitte er ramt af en fødselsdepression og har svært ved at overskue hverdagen, og hun har i stedet brugt over 20.000 kroner på Candy Crush. Kan det lykkes for eksperterne at hjælpe Birgitte ud af stilstanden og få Daniel til at støtte hende og hvordan går det, når parret endelig skal til at være helt, helt ærlige over for hinanden?

programme.title: The Notebook
programme.desc: I Seabrook, North Carolina i 1940'erne tilbringer den unge overklassepige Allie Hamilton (Rachel McAdams) og den lokale knægt Noah Calhoun (Ryan Gosling) en lidenskabelig og sorgløs sommer sammen og forelsker sig hovedløst. Men da sommeren går på hæld, adskilles det unge par af krigen og pligten. I nutiden besøger en ældre herre (James Garner) et plejehjem, hvor han læser højt af sin notesbog for en kvinde (Gena Rowlands), der er ved at miste sine minder. Mens han fortæller historien om to unge elskende, der har livet foran sig, genlever hans elskede Allie en gammel lidenskab, der aldrig døde, og det ubrydelige bånd mellem to almindelige mennesker, der ophøjes af den ægte kærligheds styrke, kraft og skønhed.

programme.title: P.S. I Love You
programme.desc: Holly og Gerry er nygifte og lykkelige! De har gode jobs, gode venner og en lækker lejlighed. Men pludselig går det galt, da Gerry efter kort tids sygdom dør og Holly står alene tilbage. Den eneste person der kunne hjælpe hende er nu væk. Det viser sig dog at Gerry har gjort sit hjemmearbejde.

programme.desc: For fem år siden blev Alice Ejbyes 18-årige søn Markus dræbt af en seriemorder, der aldrig blev fundet. Alice er nu alvorligt syg og beder derfor profiler Louise Bergstein, sin bedste venindes datter, om at hjælpe med opklaringen. Samtidigt et andet sted på Fyn får en mand ved navn Peter Vinge en fatal besked af sin kone Masja.

programme.title: For Lækker til Love
programme.desc: Camilla fra Kolding ryger helt ud i kulden på Icebar med sin københavnske badboy Jean. Og festarrangøren Søren rejser til Stockholm for at finde sig en ægte svensk blondine.

programme.title: Sommer i Magaluf
programme.desc: Nikolaj ser sig nødsaget til at rydde op i uroen på teamet, hvis ikke alt skal gå galt. Bartenderne kulturclasher med vinbonde, der ikke er forberedt på, hvordan hans drikkelse bliver indtaget.

programme.desc: I første afsnit et ton cash, går det hurtigt op for deltagerne, hvor krævende det er at flytte et helt ton mønter, gennem Råbjerg Miles sandede bakker. programme.desc: Julen nærmer sig i Chicago, og i byen er der meget fokus på en hemmelig velgører, der via folk klædt ud som elve, nisser mm. giver de fattige i byen gratis busbilletter, gratis tøj osv. Journalisten Sydney Larkin får til opgave at finde ud af, hvem byens julemand er, og mens hun arbejder med opgaven, møder hun journalisten Colin Hauer, der arbejder med samme historie for et konkurrerende medie.

programme.title: Koch'en på toppen
programme.desc: Jesper og Peter er på jagt efter en ny leverandør, som de håber kan levere ørred til hele hotellet. Men det viser sig at være lidt af en udfordring at finde frem til ørred-dambruget.

programme.title: Camp kulinaris
programme.desc: Dag 2 av finaleuken. Beregning av vekt er i søkelyset, før Kjartan blir med og lager en liten del av rettene til dagens utslagskonkurranse. Til slutt må nok en deltaker reise hjem.

programme.title: Camp kulinaris
programme.desc: Finalen er kun to dager unna! For å komme dit må de fire gjenværende deltakerne gjennom to nye konkurranser, hvor matlaging under tidspress og en veldig allsidig råvare er stikkord.

programme.title: Spin City
programme.desc: Spin City følger varaordføreren og spinndoktor Mike Flaherty og hans stab, når de kjemper for å holde ordførerkontoret flytende, og ordførerens offentlige image intakt.

programme.title: Ekstreme samlere
programme.desc: Forrest vokste opp i slummen og fortalte sønnen sin historier om et par sko han ikke hadde råd til da han var yngre. Nå er han under ekstremt økonomisk press på grunn av daglige bøter.

programme.title: NCIS: New Orleans
programme.desc: Bli med det lokale NCIS-teamet i New Orleans når de etterforsker kriminalsaker og forbrytelser mot det amerikanske militæret, i byen som er kjent for sin musikk, underholdning og dekadanse.

programme.title: NCIS

programme.desc: Rose Morgan er en ganske stressa professor som underviser i litteratur. Hun har ennå ikke funnet mannen i sitt liv, og sliter stadig med mindreverdighetskomplekser som skyldes hennes forhold til moren. Og Rose er vel kanskje ikke noen sex-bombe, heller. Når hun treffer den kjekke kollegaen Gregory, faller Rose pladask.

programme.title: Vertical Limit
programme.desc: Dette følelsesfylte action-eventyrer er en høyspent historie om en ung klatrer, Peter Garrett (Chris O'Donnel), som må sette ut på et farlig redningsoppdrag i K2, verdens nest høyeste fjelltopp, for å redde sin søster, Annie (Robin Tunney) og hennes team (Bill Paxton og Nicholas Lea). Flere år tidligere ble søsknene knust i en forferdelig klatreulykke: Peter tok en snarrådig avgjørelse om å kutte farens tau for å redde sin søster og seg selv. I ettertid isolerte Peter seg selv som naturfotograf, mens Annie jaktet på farens drøm om å bestige verdens høyeste fjelltopper. Nå er hun fanget 8000 meter over havet -- en dødsone over den vertikale grensen for utholdenhet. Hvert sekund teller når Peter og klatremannskapet bestiger verdens mest fryktede fjelltopp for å redde henne.

programme.title: Sammensvergelsen
programme.desc: Jerry Fletcher (Mel Gibson), er en New York-taxisjåfør og sammensvergelsesdyrker. Han vet om de hemmelige bakmennene og snikmorderne som egentlig kontrollerer ting. Han prøver å gjøre statsadvokat Alice Sutton (Julia Roberts) oppmerksom på dette, men blir jaget ut av hennes kontor. Snart må de begge løpe for livet. De to stjernene sammensverger seg for spenning, romantikk og en vri som tikker som et taxitaksameter i rushtiden. En sær teori i .ygebladet Jerry utgir, er kanskje sann. Den kryptiske Dr. Jonas (Patrick Stewart) og hans menn har til hensikt å knuse den - og dem også. Jeg vet ikke hva jeg vet, men jeg vet det er noe stort, sier Jerry. Det vi vet, er at Sammensvergelsen er stor underholdning.

Det betyr ikke noe at disse fem guttene nå er respekterte forretningsmenn, ektemenn og fedre. Når de samles, vil ikke noe stanse disse indre barna i å more seg som mest. Deres mål er å kidnappe to av krigsherren Mohamed Farrah Aidids nære menn for å rokke ved hans regime og gi mat til landets sultende befolkning. programme.desc: Jolian, som skal kjøre en transport mellom Stockholm og Gøteborg, får store problemer med glatt veibane. Erik gjør seg klar til å overlate selskapet til sønnen, men det er vanskeligere enn han trodde.

programme.title: Rust Valley Restorers
programme.desc: Mike og Avery prøver å få en auksjonarius til å hjelpe dem med å redusere samlingene sine, men Avery skremmer ham bort. Utfordringer gjør at Mikes restaurering av en Diamond T-lastebil havner i en blindgate.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Når datteren til Sam, Kam, blir kidnappet etter å ha deltatt i protester, gjør han alt for å finne henne igjen. I tillegg vender Deeks tilbake til NCIS, og Callen søker etter svar om Anna.

programme.title: Alert: Missing Persons Unit
programme.desc: Etter at Nikki Batistas sønn forsvinner, blir hun med i Philadelphia-politiets enhet for savnede personer, der hun senere rekrutterer sin eksmann, for å prøve å finne ham og hjelpe andre i samme situasjon.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: Når en serie brutale lagertyverier sprer seg til Los Angeles, må teamet samarbeide med politiets gjengavsnitt for å avsløre en voldelig gruppe som aldri etterlater seg levende vitner.

programme.title: Grown Ups 2
programme.desc: Lenny har flyttet tilbake til hjembyen for å komme nærmere vennene sine, men finner ganske fort ut at livet ikke blir så stille og rolig som antatt – vi møter gamle og nye bøller, skrudde bussjåfører, skikjørende politifolk, 400 gærninger som tropper opp på kostymefesten – for å nevne noe!

programme.title: Fury
programme.desc: I det de allierte gjør et siste fremstøt på den europeiske slagmarken, sender den hardbarkede hærkommandanten Wardaddy en Sherman-stridsvogn, og dens mannskap på fem, ut på et livsfarlig oppdrag bak fiendens linjer.

programme.title: Family Guy
programme.desc: Familien Griffin er en gjeng morsomme karakterer som alle bidrar på hver sin måte. Pappa Peter er en enkel sjel som stadig tråkker i salaten, mens hans tålmodige kone Lois forsøker å roe ned kaoset. Med tre barn i huset er ikke det lett, spesielt ikke når minstemann er en ondskapsfull sleiping, datteren er midt i tenårene og eldstesønnen Chris er en sløv kis. I tillegg kommer bikkja, som både drikker og prater.

programme.title: Family Guy
programme.desc: Med over 100 nominasjoner og priser er kultserien Family Guy en av verdens mest elskede. Den ikke så smarte Peter Griffin og hans dysfunksjonelle familie byr på helsprø hverdagsscenarioer som du sent vil glemme.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Elaine og Jerry arrangerer et stevnemøte mellom George og Elaines venninne Cynthia. Begge forventer et dårlig utfall av dette, og er enige om å fortelle hverandre alle detaljer de hører om hvordan kvelden har gått. Men så blir det ikke slik.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Jerry får en ny venn, men blir usikker på om dette betyr at han må hjelpe sin nye venn å flytte. Kramer har en torn i siden til Jerrys nye bekjentskap og har en voldsom historie å fortelle om ham.

programme.title: På glattisen
programme.desc: Bli med heltene som forvandler de gnistrende veiene i Norrland til farbare områder, til tross for Kong Vinters iherdige motstand. Her er snø og is hverdagskost for både bergere og brøytebiler.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Vi følger en familiedrevet pantesjappe i Las Vegas. Tre generasjoner av Harrison-familien lever og ånder for virksomheten, der de bruker sin kunnskap for å sikre seg verdifulle, spesielle og historiske gjenstander.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: En utgave av «The Dance of Death» fra 1547 hjemsøker sjappa. To skulpturer fra Dr. Seuss' uortodokse samling av utstoppede dyr bringes inn. Senere tvinger en tåregassbatong seg inn.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Tre generasjoner Harrison jobber dag og natt for pantelånerkontoret sitt, Gold And Silver Pawn Shop i Las Vegas. I det daglige møter bestefar Rick, far Corey og sønnesønn Richard mennesker med interessante historier rundt tingene de vil pante, men alt er ikke bare solskinn i familieforretningen.

programme.title: Kongen av Queens
programme.desc: Doug og Carrie bestemmer seg for å bytte inn bilen, men må dra tomhendte hjem. Arthur har imidlertid bestemt seg for å gi Doug og Carrie en tidlig julepresang og kan med stolthet overrekke nøklene til en liten europeisk bil. Til tross for at Doug og Carrie virkelig trenger en ny bil, er de ikke særlig fornøyde med gaven - og hvordan skal de bli kvitt bilen uten å såre Arthur?

programme.title: Kongen av Queens
programme.desc: Amerikansk komiserie. Doug Heffernan jobber som sjåførbud og bor sammen med sin kone Carrie. Men når svigerfar flytter inn, blir deres enkle tilværelse plutselig snudd opp ned

programme.title: Kalla fakta: Svenska incels
programme.desc: S2021 E9I extrema forum på nätet träffas unga ensamma män som lever i ofrivilligt celibat. Där kan deras längtan efter kärlek och samhörighet snabbt förvandlas till ilska och hat. Kalla faktas team har tagit sig förbi säkerhetsspärrarna på världens största incelforum och intervjuat några av de svenska incelmännen om deras tankegångar. De berättar om ensamhet men också om självförakt och kvinnohat.

programme.title: Plastikkirurgerna
programme.desc: S1 E9Lulu Carter kommer till kliniken och vill göra något åt sin hud på halsen, som hon tycker är flammig. Hon har beslutat att genomgå en kemisk peeling. Christina har haft bröstcancer. Hon tvingades ta bort ett av sina bröst och nu ska hon genomgå en rekonstruktion för att få ett nytt. Läkaren Janne ska ta en bit av hennes mage och förvandla till ett nytt bröst, vilket är en avancerad operation.\n\nPernilla är 39 år och tycker att hennes haka är för tjock. Hon kommer till läkaren Riikka för att fettsuga sig och genomgå botoxinjektioner.

Fredrik inser att problemet inte ligger hos Hugo utan hos husse Peter som daltar för mycket med hunden. Sedan beger sig Fredrik till Uppsala och träffar hunden Majki som är lite väl närgången mot andra hundar.

programme.title: Hundcoachen
programme.desc: S2 E14 — Avsnitt 14Hundcoachen Fredrik åker till Mariefred för att ta sig an hunden Rocky som är aggressiv mot andra hundar. Sanna, Rockys matte, märker att vettskrämda grannar undviker dem eftersom hon har svårt att kontrollera sin hund.

programme.title: Veterinärerna
programme.desc: S5 E1 — The Wild Life of Dr. OleVeterinären Kalle Nordfeldt och hans kollegor på Skånes djurpark stöter på problem när de ska flytta oxdjuren visenterna som är några av parkens farligaste djur. \n\nKatten Cindy har varit i slagsmål och tvingas operera svansen. Pudeln Axl är en riktig tjejtjusare och blir därför kastrerad av veterinären Suzanne Sandquist. Veterinären Cecilia Rhodin tvingas ge dåliga nyheter till franska bulldoggen Elvis husse och matte efter att en magnetröntgen avslöjat en tumör.

programme.title: Linda och djurens hjältar
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Avsnitt 1I Sydafrika som i resten av världen brer människor ut sig vilket leder till att djuren kommer för nära människorna och till och med in i deras hus. Det finns de som vigt sitt liv åt att rädda människor från farliga djur och Linda möter några av dem.

programme.title: Bygglov
programme.desc: S3 E7 — Avsnitt 7Tioårige Emil vill ha ett eget rum.

programme.title: Kalla fakta: När våldet vann
programme.desc: Isabella förlorade vårdnaden om sonen när hon på grund av våldet inte ville samarbeta med barnets pappa. Hon är inte ensam. En ny rapport visar att domstolarna ofta inte väger in uppgifter om våld i sina beslut. Det kan leda till att barn tvingas att bo med en våldsutövande förälder.

programme.title: Familjen Annorlunda
programme.desc: S4 E6 — Avsnitt 6Hos familjen Norrström får pappa Peter ta hand om marktjänsten när mamma Mirka åker bort en vecka. Hemma hos familjen Wallquist ställer pappa Walle en efterlängtad fråga. Familjen Wahlström firar födelsedag med ett teaterbesök.

programme.title: Plastikkirurgerna
programme.desc: S2 E1Säsongsstart. Jannice har drabbats av ansiktsförlamningar som har lett till att hennes ansikte är osymmetriskt. Jenny har genomgått två magsäcksoperationer som hjälpte henne att gå ner 70 kilo i vikt. Hon har nu en mängd överflödig hud.

programme.title: Bygglov
programme.desc: S2 E8 — Bygglov S02 E008Gänget besöker ett pensionat i Rättvik.

programme.title: Familjen Annorlunda
programme.desc: S4 E7 — Avsnitt 7Familjen Wallquist åker till Stockholm över helgen men alla vill göra olika saker. Familjen Norrström delar upp sig så att mamma och pappa får lite egen tid med några av barnen. Familjen Wahlström besöker en gymnastiksal där barnen får leka av sig.

programme.title: Anders knackar på
programme.desc: S3 E3 — Hanna HellquistHanna Hellquist gård är full av drömmar och halvfärdiga projekt, något som får Anders att vilja slita av sig håret. Han försöker få Hanna att slutföra det hon påbörjat men hon vill hellre gå på loppis. Att ta hand om en läckande pool kan vänta.

programme.title: Veterinärerna
programme.desc: S5 E2 — The Wild Life of Dr. OleCarina tar med sin dräktiga hund Yava till veterinären Monica Landström i Läckeby. De vill ta reda på hur många valpar det rör sig om men röntgenbilderna ger ett oväntat resultat\n\nVeterinären Emma Lindell ska operera tävlingshästen Moe men det går inte som planerat. Katten Trixi tvingas genomgå flera prover för att utreda vad hennes höga njurvärden beror på, något som gör husse Jonas orolig.

programme.title: Sicario
programme.desc: En idealistisk FBI-agent värvas till en specialstyrka av dess chef för att jaga rätt på en mexikansk kartellboss. Hon kastas ut i ett farofyllt uppdrag som tvingar henne att ifrågasätta allt som hon tror på - och ställer henne mot en skum konsult med en livsfarlig agenda.

programme.desc: Kumail vet redan innan han träffar Emily att det inte är okomplicerat att övervinna uråldriga traditioner och skyhöga förväntningar hos sin familj. Föräldrarnas högsta önskan är nämligen att han utbildar sig till advokat och gifter sig med en välutbildad tjej av pakistanskt ursprung.

programme.title: Den gränslöse
programme.desc: Rose skickas till Bornholm för att delta i en avskedsfest för en av Mørcks vänner. Där dras Mørck, Assad och Rose in i ett gammalt fall där en ung flicka mördats, och en koppling upptäcks mellan den lokala polisen och en soldyrkande kult.

programme.title: Young Victoria
programme.desc: Några månader efter sin 18-årsdag blir prinsessan Viktoria krönt till drottning efter hennes farbrors, kung Vilhelm IV, död. Hon hade ingen lycklig barndom utan var tvungen att leva efter Kensington-reglerna.

programme.title: A Rainy Day in New York
programme.desc: Historien om collegekärleksparet Gatsby (Timothée Chalamet) och Ashleigh (Elle Fanning) vars planer om en romantisk helg tillsammans i New York City går om intet lika snabbt som solen går i moln och blir till regn. De två skiljs snart åt och får på varsitt håll uppleva en rad slumpmöten och komiska äventyr. Under den drömlika och regniga dagen i New York upptäcker Ashleigh att hon kanske inte är den som hon trodde att hon var och Gatsby inser att även om man bara lever en gång så räcker det om man bara hittar rätt person.

programme.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
programme.desc: Harrison Ford och Liam Neeson syns i Kathryn Bigelows thriller från kalla kriget där en nybyggd atomubåt ska ut på en nervig jungfruresa.

programme.title: No Man's Land
programme.desc: Jackson och hans pappa patrullerar vid gränsen när Jackson råkar döda en mexikansk immigrantpojke. Hans pappa tar på sig skulden och Jackson flyr söderut till häst och blir en illegal gringoimmigrant i Mexiko. Jagad av Texas Rangers och den mexikanska federala polisen färdas Jackson genom Mexiko för att be den döda pojkens pappa om förlåtelse och under resans gång blir han förälskad i landet som han har fått lära sig att hata.

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: Den verklighetsbaserade historien om Molly Bloom, landslagsåkerskan i puckelpist som efter en svår fallolycka sadlar om till slipad pokervärdinna för filmstjärnor, sportgiganter och makthavare.

programme.title: Marcoeffekten
programme.desc: Kontraktsmord och svindel i miljonklassen blottläggs när Carl Mørck och Avdelning Q börjar gräva i en nedlagd brottsutredning om den försvunne pedofilimisstänkte UD-tjänstemannen William Stark.

programme.title: Sicario 2: Soldado
programme.desc: I drogkriget finns det inga regler - och när kartellerna börjar smuggla in terrorister till USA vänder sig Matt Graver till den mystiske Alejandro, vars familj mördades av en kartellboss, för att trappa upp kriget på vidrigt vis.

programme.title: Åsa-Nisse flyger i luften
programme.desc: Åsa-Nisse och Klabbarparn reser till Åre där de träffar direktör Jonsson som de försöker sälja en uppfinning till.

programme.title: North to Home
programme.desc: Suzanne McBride ser fram emot att fira sin födelsedag med familjen i Alaska. För första gången på flera år kommer alla hennes tre adopterade döttrar att tillbringa tid tillsammans. Det är upplagt för en härlig återförening, men systrarna brottas alla med olika utmaningar som riskerar att färga av sig på festligheterna.

programme.title: A New Year's Resolution
programme.desc: Romantiskt drama om tv-producenten Kelly som jobbat alldeles för mycket och ger ett nyårslöfte att säga ja till alla inbjudningar under hela januari.

programme.title: Bombshell - När tystnaden bryts
programme.desc: Bombshell - När tystnaden bryts är baserad på den verkliga skandalen och berättar den sprängladdade historien om kvinnorna som bringade Roger Aisles på fall. Han var en av männen bakom Fox News, historiens mäktigaste och mest kontroversiella mediaimperium. Berättelsens kärna är en inspirerande skildring av hur modet växer fram i kampen mot överheten när tre väldigt olika kvinnor beslutar sig för att bryta tystnaden och slå tillbaka mot den otyglade makten och dess sexuella trakasserier och övergrepp.

programme.title: Minari
programme.desc: Sexfaldigt Oscarsnominerade Minari handlar om Jacob och Monica, som lämnat Korea för möjligheternas land USA. De har tillbringat några motiga år i Kalifornien där barnen Anne och David tillkommit, och nu går familjens flyttlass till Arkansas landsbygd där Jacob vill försöka sig på att odla koreanska grönsaker. Monica gillar inte sin nya tillvaro i en sliten gammal villavagn, och ser fram emot att hennes mamma Soonja snart ska komma från Korea för att bo hos dem och hjälpa till med barnen. Det visar sig att rappkäftade Soonja med sina egenheter ibland är till mer besvär än hjälp, och sjuårige David tycker ofta mormor är pinsamt koreansk. Men den amerikanska vischan är en främmande värld där en udda familj kan svetsas samman för att de är annorlunda, samtidigt som de hittar oväntade vänner på vägen. Minari är en ömsint berättelse om hur såväl växter som människor försöker rota sig och hitta hem på okänd mark. Filmen har fått en rad priser, däribland en Golden Globe, och kan vinna Oscar bland annat för Bästa film.

programme.title: Hemma i Hampstead
programme.desc: Kärleken kan hittas på de mest oväntade platser - som vid den gigantiska parken Hampstead Heath i London. Emily (Diane Keaton), en amerikansk änka bor i ett pittoreskt hus i ytterkanten av Hampstead Heath och Donald (Brendan Gleeson) lever ett harmoniskt enslingsliv i ett självbyggt kyffe en bit in i parken sedan 17 år.

programme.title: Pappa på burk
programme.desc: Kassie och Wally är bästa vänner men det Kassie inte vet är att Wally är förälskad i henne. Kassie bestämmer sig för att skaffa barn med hjälp av en donator. När det är dags för befruktning ställer hon till med fest och Wally råkar av misstag spilla ut donatorns sperma och ersätter den med sin egen.

programme.title: Wild Rose
programme.desc: Jessie Buckleys explosiva sångbegåvning och unika personlighet går rakt genom bioduken. Upplev Jessies omtalade genombrottsroll i gripande Wild Rose, en historia om de vägar livet tar om man vägrar ge upp sig själv och sina drömmar. Unga upproriska Rose-Lynn har aldrig velat något annat än att sjunga, men har hittills bara uppträtt på små lokala scener. Hon brinner för den råa country som består av tre ackord och sanningen om livet, men vägen från Glasgow till Nashville är lång - speciellt för en arbetartjej som klarat av ett fängelsestraff och som blev mamma redan i tonåren. Medan Rose-Lynn jagar framgången söker hennes två barn trygghet hos hennes egen mamma Marion (Julie Walters), som tagit sina snytingar och ser mer realistiskt på tillvaron. Genom ett städjobb får Rose-Lynn kontakter som kan leda till en sångkarriär på allvar. Nu satsar hon allt, men vad är hon beredd att förlora på vägen? Jessie Buckley spelar Ljudmila i seriesuccén Chernobyl och kommer i en rad filmer, bland annat Judy med Renée Zellweger och Ironbark med Benedict Cumberbatch.

programme.title: The Nile Hilton Incident
programme.desc: Noredin (Fares Fares) är en korrupt kriminalpolis i centrala Kairo som satt i rutin att pressa lokala brottslingar på pengar. I ett rus av droger och alkohol håller han sig flytande i ett rättssystem som är på randen till kollaps.

programme.title: G.I. Jane
programme.desc: Löjtnant Jordan O'Neil väljs ut för ett test om kvinnlig närvaro i en kommandotrupp på elitnivå där 60% av männen hoppar av. Hon är fast besluten att bevisa att hon klarar av det.
